about.name: Coach Chris Davenport
about.title: DC/Linebackers
about.bio:
Coach Chris Davenport is a proven 3-3-5 specialist with 18 years of coaching experience at Calumet College of St. Joseph. Known for a disciplined, film-first approach, Coach Davenport develops intelligent, technically sound players who make an impact on every down.

If you're looking to elevate your game on the defensive side of the ball and compete at the next level, Coach Davenport's coaching is where that journey starts.

hero.headline: Calumet College of St. Joseph's Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized defensive football coaching that turns potential into performance.

services.title: 3-3-5 Defense Installation
services.description: Full 3-3-5 system installation — formations, assignments, stunts, and blitz packages tailored to your personnel.

services.title: Film & Opponent Scouting
services.description: Tendency charting, defensive game-planning, and film breakdown sessions that give your defense the edge before kickoff.

services.title: Linebacker & Secondary Development
services.description: Position-specific coaching for front-seven and DB players — gap control, coverage technique, communication, and tackling.
